title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 Scalar Option Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, requirement-home trace tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9463 encrypted DNS scalar option surface.
scope: This verification covers assigned option code constants, 32-bit lifetime constants and predicates, required ADN validation, minimum usable resolver address validation, host-side loopback and multicast address filtering, forbidden address-hint SvcParam rejection, and 16-bit service priority storage.
preconditions: The RFC 9463 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9463.json`.
The RFC 9463 scalar discovery behavior remains in `Incursa.Quic.Dns` rather than in the QUIC transport runtime.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9463 tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9463 artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The RFC 9463 encrypted DNS scalar option policy floor is trace-owned and verified. DHCPv6, DHCPv4, and Neighbor Discovery wire codecs, RFC 8415 domain-name encoding, full RFC 9460 SvcParam handling, and resolver provisioning remain future work.
